title: Work and personal agent accounts
description: Add another login for an agent directly from Jackalope.
items: An upfront Add account & sign in flow makes additional accounts easier to discover.
Label existing and saved accounts as Work, Personal or Other without opening an edit dialog.
Choose a newly connected account for future tasks from the sign-in screen.
note: In development. Real multi-account sign-in validation remains pending.

title: Jackalope notification branding
description: Windows task notifications now include the Jackalope logo.
items: Test notifications share the same branding as task updates.
Added breathing room below the notification settings divider.
note: In development. Native visual verification is pending.

title: Simpler settings header
description: Settings now opens directly at its heading.
items: Removed the extra Back to workspace link.
note: In development.

title: One choice for product emails
description: The signup product-notes choice now includes a one-time feedback email after trying Jackalope.
items: The signup choice starts checked, and the separate feedback-email switch is removed from account settings.
Existing opt-outs remain respected, with consent checked again before sending.
note: In development. Matching service and website deployment is pending.

title: Simpler privacy settings
description: Privacy settings are easier to scan.
items: Short summaries keep the choices clear, with expandable details for settings sync and usage sharing.
note: In development.

title: Clearer floating actions
description: Floating action bars are easier to distinguish from the content beneath them.
items: Added subtle theme-aware borders and consistent spacing to task, connection and repository todo actions.
note: In development.

title: Clearer worktree cleanup
description: Clean up merged worktrees when only disposable build output or dependencies remain.
items: See which worktrees are ready and which generated folders cleanup removes.
Keep local edits, configuration and unrecognized ignored files protected, including during archive and remove.
note: In development. Combined desktop verification is pending.

title: More room for task details.
description: Expanded task controls have clearer spacing and more consistent field sizes.
items: Separate workflow labels and inputs, space context sections consistently and keep guideline cards from stretching with their neighbors.
Keep the large prompt style on task intent, with normal sizing for workflow fields.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: Tidier project preferences.
description: Project settings are easier to scan and appearance settings have more breathing room.
items: Align project fields in a consistent column, grouped into instructions, workspace and verification.
Add spacing before the project theme picker and remove companion previews from appearance settings.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: A flatter command shortcut.
description: The top-bar Jump to control fits more quietly into the workspace.
items: Removed the inset shadow from the Jump to search control.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: Start with what you want to do.
description: Create and dispatch tasks directly from the Tasks page.
items: A large inline composer puts your intent, project and start action first, with compact effort and configuration controls.
Keep drafts, save ideas for later and find existing work below the composer. New task shortcuts focus the prompt directly.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: Clearer helper bubbles.
description: Helper messages stand out against your workspace theme.
items: Speech bubbles and brief notification hints use dark backgrounds with light text in light themes, and light backgrounds with dark text in dark themes.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: Keep quick confirmations temporary.
description: Brief helper messages disappear after they have been shown.
items: Copy confirmations and other temporary speech no longer become companion inbox entries or unread notifications.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: See when a pass is copied.
description: Pass tickets confirm when their invitation link is copied.
items: The clicked desktop pass briefly shows Copied with a checkmark after a successful copy, alongside the helper confirmation.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: Recover from a page error.
description: A page that fails to open now offers a way back into Jackalope.
items: Keep workspace navigation and the helper available after a page error, with options to return to tasks or reload.
note: In development. Included in the next desktop release.

title: A tidier appearance page.
description: Personalize your workspace with a compact theme editor and control over the top-bar picker.
items: The settings theme editor uses a width closer to the pop-out picker.
A saved checkbox lets you hide the top-bar theme picker while keeping Appearance settings available.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: Share a head start.
description: Early access passes share colorful ticket designs across the website and desktop, while desktop connections are easier to follow.
items: Open an available pass to copy its link or send an email invitation.
The same ticket artwork, colors and availability states appear in the app and on the website.
The in-app invitation screen keeps the focus on passes and sharing, with less introductory copy.
The companion confirms when an invitation link or message is copied.
Connected desktops refresh automatically and show computer names from updated apps.
Centered approval guidance makes it clear when to return to Jackalope.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: App version on the welcome screen.
description: See which version of Jackalope is running before connecting your account.
items: The welcome footer shows the current app version alongside the name and Early access label.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: Connect once, set up each project.
description: Check early access and app privacy on launch, then set up projects with their own agent choices.
items: An animated access check leads into reusable Project, Agent and First task steps, with a project default and switches for detected agents.
New connections default to settings sync, with an opt-out before connecting and saved opt-outs preserved.
Sync appearance and notification choices with strict privacy controls and conflict review.
Delete the saved settings copy and disable sync across connected desktops.
note: Development milestone; updated desktop and hosted application rollout still require acceptance.

title: Worktrees without the wait
description: Workspaces appear before cleanup checks finish.
items: Task and feature worktrees load independently of cleanup checks, with retryable errors for slow reads. Primary, main and master checkouts stay out of the list.
Cleanup checks avoid enumerating ignored dependency folders while retaining deletion safeguards.
The desktop companion sits slightly lower in its footer.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: A workspace that is ready to use
description: Project settings, agent preferences and connected tools are easier to find and configure.
items: Share project settings between Settings and the project workspace, with agent and account permissions and optional project themes.
Open agent configuration directly from its card and discover model catalogs from supported CLIs.
Use one MCP connection editor for the marketplace and custom connections, with project and agent scope controls.
Open an automatically prepared codebase map with a compact toolbar and visual checks.
Warm account quotas, model catalogs and tool settings during setup; show remaining invitations and a livelier working companion.
note: In development. CLI support and account access determine available models and connections.

title: More room, less waiting
description: Full workspace pages and automatic refresh make browsing and configuration easier.
items: MCP details and configuration move into dedicated pages, with publisher avatars on listings and clearer actions.
App Settings gets its own page. Agents use a card grid, discover runners on arrival, and explain when an Antigravity desktop install needs the CLI.
Usage loads quotas automatically and refreshes stale data. Marketplace, connection and knowledge reads reuse recent results, while page scrollbars stay at the workspace edge.
Performance insights includes an automatic quota handoff switch, enabled by default, without the duplicate capacity section.
note: Disabling quota handoff preserves partial work for review. Existing preferences keep handoff enabled.

title: Computer use and agent browser, together.
description: The homepage now highlights browser actions and approved Windows app control in the main feature grid.
items: See what agents can do in a task browser or a selected Windows window, with visible pause and cancel controls.
note: Website copy update; deployment remains pending.

title: Your project at a glance
description: Repository knowledge is easier to scan and turn into work.
items: Project Context groups source files, technologies, instructions and commands in a visual overview.
Lessons and workflows use compact cards with full content available on demand.
Repo TODOs offer a Start task action with prefilled context. Completion moves into explicit edit controls, with Cancel and Discard beside the document heading.
note: Tasks remain yours to review and start; repository edits still require Save changes.

title: A calmer wait
description: Loading views use consistent, understated visual feedback.
items: Subtle spinners and placeholders replace bare loading text across the workspace.
Compact checks keep a small status indicator, and loading animation respects reduced motion.
note: Indicators follow real loading state without adding delays.

title: Stay in control of desktop assistance.
description: A clear status bar and theme-colored glow show when Jackalope is using your computer.
items: Pause or cancel from the top bar, press Escape to cancel, and explicitly resume after mouse, keyboard or window interruptions.
Larger display-scaled text and working controls keep desktop assistance readable.
The landing page gives the mobile New task preview more bottom space.
note: Development milestone. Disposable Windows checks pass; installed-agent and packaged-app acceptance remain separate.

title: Recurring work, clearly configured
description: Create routines with instructions, timing and behavior laid out together.
items: The wider schedule editor keeps settings visible and its save controls in place.
Daily, weekday and weekly routines use a time picker, with custom cron timing preserved.
Template search places the icon inside the field and removes the extra introductory note.
note: Existing schedules, saved context and paused defaults remain supported.

title: A useful place to start
description: An empty Tasks view offers clear next steps.
items: Start a task, then use the shortcut grid to explore the codebase, choose agents, connect tools or schedule recurring work.
note: Actions open the existing workspace flows without starting work automatically.

title: Knowledgebase, architecture guides, and in-app help
description: A clean, searchable Knowledgebase on the marketing website covers common questions, architecture guides, and troubleshooting recipes, with direct access from the desktop app.
items: Search guides, visual architecture diagrams, and troubleshooting recipes across nine feature categories.
Access the Knowledgebase directly from the desktop shell using the new header life preserver shortcut, the Command Palette, or Settings.
note: Structured Schema.org FAQ data and AI search engine files (llms.txt) provide comprehensive discovery.

title: More room to jump around
description: Workspace navigation feels more at home in your theme.
items: A wider command control uses neutral light/dark glass and a subtle inset shadow.
Help, settings, appearance and task shortcuts use themed tooltips with keyboard support.
note: Available in the development build.

title: A prepared workspace from the start
description: A friendly welcome gives Jackalope time to prepare your workspace.
items: Setup refreshes history and agents, checks the project, reads repository context and prepares a reusable local codebase map.
Preparation stays visible for at least five seconds, with accurate progress and recovery for slow or failed checks.
note: Preparation runs locally without launching agent tasks or installing dependencies.

title: A clearer agent setup
description: Agent setup is easier to scan and fits smaller windows.
items: Removed detected counts and skill badges, with company names shown as subtle text.
Expanded installation commands wrap within the setup pane.
A subtle border separates the floating step actions from scrolling content.
note: In development.

title: Local LLM discovery, cross-model review, visual DAG and insights
description: Orchestrate multi-agent teams with zero-latency local model discovery, privacy-preserving API key detection, peer code reviews, visual dependency graphs, and an actionable insights dashboard.
items: Discover running local inference servers (Ollama, LM Studio, llama.cpp) and ambient environment API keys with local-only privacy guarantees and opt-in import.
Request independent cross-model peer reviews on workspace diffs before merging, surfacing security and correctness advisories.
Visualize feature subtasks, dependencies, agent avatars, and active parallel execution in an interactive DAG graph.
Explore speed, cost, and token performance comparisons across agents, with mascot-delivered workflow optimization tips and quota rescue analytics.
note: Available in the local development build; native agent and live provider acceptance remain pending.

title: More agents. Less juggling.
description: Explore Jackalope with a clearer overview and features that open in place.
items: A bolder landing page puts the app preview and six expandable features up front.
Join the waitlist directly from product pages or the homepage form.
A dedicated roadmap keeps future plans together while product guides focus on the current workflow.
note: Development milestone; public downloads are not open yet.

title: Your agents, accounts, and tools together
description: A clearer landing-page overview of project agent lineups, routing, tool discovery, and cross-agent coordination, plus explicit Windows desktop window access.
items: See how work and personal accounts, project agent restrictions, automatic routing, MCP discovery, and agent messages fit together.
Grant one Windows window to an active task for snapshots, captures, focus, clicks, literal typing, and scrolling; Stop or release revokes access.
note: Native window control is Windows-only and requires a human window choice for each attempt. Live routing and installed-agent desktop acceptance remain pending.

title: Task routing with quota awareness
description: Jackalope's default agent can select an enabled agent, configured model and account for automatic tasks.
items: Uses reported quota headroom and local active-work reservations when admitting work.
Hands quota-interrupted tasks to an eligible fallback in the same workspace with progress and usage retained.
Shows routing decisions and attributes routing and worker usage separately.
note: In development. Missing quota remains unknown; live provider handoff acceptance is still pending. Explicit assignments remain pinned.

title: A more expressive companion
description: Jackalope adds small character reactions and more tactile theme controls.
items: The idle companion blinks occasionally and gently follows the mouse, with activity expressions taking priority.
Successful setup steps get a quick nod before advancing. Reduced motion skips these gestures.
Atmosphere reaches a richer maximum of 64 and uses a thicker vertical pill handle with a generous drag area.
note: Available in the local development build; native release acceptance is still pending.

title: Clearer button and tab states.
description: Primary buttons favor readable white labels, and selected tabs use subtle elevation.
items: Borderline action fills deepen slightly while preserving the chosen theme color elsewhere.
Selected theme, task, queue and MCP tabs use a shared shadow instead of a bottom-edge highlight.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: Palettes that follow your color.
description: Choose Single, Duo or Trio to build a coordinated theme from one primary color.
items: Companion colors and workspace gradients update as you explore the color picker.
Palette previews preserve cancel, reset and saved themes, with readable action labels on hover.
Atmosphere has a richer high end while keeping existing saved themes unchanged.
Choosing automatic appearance keeps the theme picker layout steady.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: A focused start to setup.
description: Choose your theme first, then review privacy choices when setting up a project.
items: Privacy choices appear only on step two, with saved opt-outs preserved.
Agent setup saves your app-wide default and points to Settings for more customization.
Re-scan agents is easy to find at the top right of the setup pane.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: A closer look at Jackalope.
description: A more expressive landing page brings the workspace and its parallel workflow into focus.
items: An oversized animated brand mark frames the actual app, with a quick path to the tour and waitlist.
Explore parallel tasks earlier, review the interface, and try palettes across the page.
note: Website development milestone, not a public app release.

title: Feedback after you have tried Jackalope
description: Share thoughts after reviewing real task results, with optional email follow-up and quiet in-app invitations.
items: Control invitations, snooze requests, and stop this feedback round after responding.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: A new look at Jackalope in motion.
description: Watch our 32-second launch film from the landing page or app tour.
items: See parallel agent work, the agent roster, and review in a light-theme animated preview with music and captions.
note: The preview uses sample project data. Join the waitlist for early access.

title: Expanded agent ecosystem and multi-agent routing.
description: Support for 8 coding agents, broad package manager discovery, multi-account tags, intelligent task routing, and interactive multi-agent decomposition.
items: Built-in detection across npm, pnpm, yarn, pipx, scoop, cargo, winget, and brew for Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, Antigravity, Gemini CLI, Aider, and Goose.
Multi-account custom tagging, visual badges, and one-click import of default CLI logins.
Automatic best-fit task routing and interactive goal splitting into sequenced subtasks across specialized agents.
note: Prerelease milestone. Desktop builds pass all automated verification checks.

title: Your next hop into Jackalope.
description: Track your waitlist place, bring people along, and share Instant Access Passes once you are in.
items: Unlimited verified waitlist referrals earn priority, with progress visible to you and the admin.
Accepted members get five passes to bring people straight into early access.
Clear emails guide verification, referral milestones, pass claims, and expired reservations.
note: Development milestone. Service migration and real email acceptance are required before rollout.

title: A cross-platform workspace.
description: Jackalope's public copy and launch assets now describe a cross-platform workspace for coding agents.
items: The launch film, submission images, captions and outreach copy use a shared early-access invitation.
note: Development milestone, not a public release. The first launch is planned for macOS, Windows, and Linux.

title: A clearer path into Jackalope.
description: Explore the current workspace and help shape our first cross-platform launch.
items: Optional signup preferences and admin insights guide onboarding.
Find invitations, compare workflows, and watch the updated app tour.
note: Development milestone. Deployment and cross-platform installed acceptance remain pending.

title: Newsletter artwork stays behind the signup.
description: The folding Echo outline now remains behind the early-access form as it animates.
items: The signup surface keeps its text and controls clear in light and dark appearances.
note: Development milestone, not a public release.

title: Follow Jackalope on X.
description: The website now makes Jackalope's official X profile easy to find from every page.
items: A Follow on X link is available in the shared footer.
note: Website milestone, not a public product release.

title: A clearer view of parallel work.
description: The website now shows how different kinds of agent work move through Jackalope instead of repeating one generic workflow diagram.
items: Three animated scenes distinguish feature delivery, regression tracing, and open-ended design exploration.
Route lines, layered studies, and evidence cards extend the visual language used in Jackalope campaign artwork.
The early-access form now uses the same line motif and a higher-contrast theme-colored action.
Focused discovery pages explain parallel agents, Git worktrees, supported adapters, project context, recurring work, and review.
note: Website milestone, not a public product release. Motion respects reduced-motion preferences.

title: More of the work, in one place.
description: The current development build brings task work and project context into a more focused workspace.
items: Tasks groups active work, saved evidence, and recurring work. Project holds codebase exploration, worktrees, and context.
Project tool selections can travel with Codex and Claude Code task launches, while existing CLI-global tools remain available.
Recurring work includes timezone and missed-run controls. The app must remain running; it cannot wake a closed app or a sleeping computer.
Account-aware usage views and locally bundled fonts are part of the current development build.
note: Development milestone, not a public release. Installed-app acceptance, signing, and the first public Windows installer remain pending.

title: A first look at Jackalope.
description: A place to explore the product and follow what comes next.
items: Real interface captures in light and dark appearances, using an explicitly fictional Atlas project.
An interactive recorded tour covering task drafting, patch review, agent selection, and the live theme palette.
A three-step introduction, product notes, and an early-access waitlist.
note: The walkthrough illustrates the interface with sample data. It does not launch an agent task.
